assay_mapping.mapping_rule: identity mapping to GDPa1 column names; no learned or post-score mapping

expected_information_gain.definition: using the same continuous conditional liability probabilities as the frozen selector, choose the remaining assay with maximum H_b(p); observing the assay resolves that binary liability variable, so H_b(p) is its one-step expected information gain

forbidden: claim that warning thresholds are clinically dispositive
claim that the selector chooses which real wet-lab assay should be run without domain-specific assay cost and operational constraints
claim_boundary.if_signal: On this exact non-Jain-overlap GDPa1 complete-case cohort, the frozen continuous conditional-risk selector exposed predeclared developability warning-threshold crossings with fewer assay units than every preregistered comparator without higher budget-3 false reassurance than the strongest efficiency baseline.

cost.definition: one observed assay equals one cost unit

external_policy.source: central Ginkgo 2025 warning thresholds already frozen for CPG-002

missingness.primary_rule: complete-case across all eight frozen external assays after Jain-overlap exclusion

overlap_exclusion.jain_identity_basis: candidate_ids from frozen canonical Jain cohort

primary_evaluation.baseline_champion_rule: lowest mean assays to first liability; ties by lower budget-3 false reassurance; then baseline name ascending
primary_evaluation.efficiency_metric: mean assays to first declared liability among liability-positive primary candidates
primary_evaluation.safety_metric: false reassurance fraction after three assays
signal_requires: selector mean assays to first liability is strictly lower than every admissible baseline
paired bootstrap 95% lower bound for champion_minus_selector mean cost is greater than zero
selector budget-3 false reassurance is no greater than the efficiency champion baseline

selector.reuse: execute the exact frozen Jain selector implementation with only the prospectively frozen external ASSAY_ORDER and threshold objects substituted
